title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.33412v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBe

translated_title: 解决状态表示失配问题：面向开环VLA规划的状态空间视觉推理
translated_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型取得了快速进展，现有推理范式在开环规划中仍面临一个根本性的状态表示失配问题。在仅有初始观测的条件下，模型必须在内部模拟动作条件下的状态转移，而文本空间、像素空间和潜在空间推理分别会遭受有损空间压缩、误差累积的视觉生成以及绕过中间潜在词元等问题，从而削弱了可靠的长期规划能力。我们提出状态空间视觉推理（SSVR），将静态视觉上下文、语言约束和循环潜在状态进行解耦。SSVR仅需对初始图像和指令编码一次，之后每次动作预测均以潜在状态为条件，并通过动作条件GRU对其进行更新。以Qwen2.5-VL作为骨干网络，SSVR在FrozenLake、Maze和MiniBe数据集上分别取得了99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0和83.9/90.6的EM/PR成绩。
tldr: 提出状态空间视觉推理（SSVR），通过将静态视觉上下文、语言约束与由动作条件GRU更新的循环潜在状态解耦，解决了开环VLA规划中的状态表示失配问题，显著提升了长期规划的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes State-Space Visual Reasoning (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state updated by an action-conditioned GRU, resolving the state-representation mismatch in open-loop VLA planning and enabling reliable long-horizon planning.
